name: Truthfuli for Home
imageAlt: Truthfuli smart home utility monitoring app shown on a phone
description: Smart home solution that eliminates utility uncertainty across gas, power, and internet.
longDescription: Truthfuli is a smart home solution that eliminates utility uncertainty by monitoring gas, power, and internet in real time. It sends proactive alerts before gas runs low, supports effortless refill ordering, pinpoints outages, and notifies providers before daily disruptions become surprises.
